task: Welcome to another fast paced round of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First step, retrieve the fudge scented latchkey from the floor of the canteen. And then, unlock the fudge scented portal inside the canteen. And then, open the fudge scented portal. After that, try to head north. Following that, take a trip west. That done, retrieve the fresh laundry scented latchkey from the floor of the cookery. And then, go east. With that accomplished, venture south. Then, unlock the fresh laundry scented gateway. After that, open the fresh laundry scented gateway in the canteen. After that, head south. Then, make sure that the spherical door is unlocked with the spherical latchkey. If you have unlocked the spherical door, ensure that the spherical door is open. And then, make an attempt to venture south. Then, make an attempt to go south. Okay, and then, make an effort to move west. After that, make an attempt to take a trip west. With that done, recover the spork from the floor of the scullery. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
